details.s: Elros, also known as Elros Tar-Minyatur, the Half-elven, was the son of Eärendil and Elwing, brother of Elrond, uncle of Elladan and Elrohir and Arwen, and the first King of Númenor; ancestor to a line of kings that led to his distant descendant Aragorn II. He had a strong friendship with the Elves, who were half his kin.
f: Ñoldor (House of Fingolfin), Sindar (House of Thingol), Dúnedain of Númenor (House of Elros)
